markers.to: 01: I ↔ II; northern route from the trench junction
01: II ↔ III; lower western passage beyond Ramtusk
01: III ↔ IV; bridges to the Bat Cavern
Unverified: 01 IV → I; reported one-way drop behind Charlga toward the prison

uncertain: The dashed trench passage in I preserves the documented connection to the prison. Exact turns, side recesses and the detailed Willix escort track require an in-game survey.
Dashed bridges in III show the documented sequence of elevated crossings; exact vine curvature and intermediate landing geometry are not verified.
Marker 6 denotes the Blind Hunter search area in the Bat Cavern, not a verified fixed spawn point.
Dashed transition D is a reported drop behind Charlga toward the prison. Its precise takeoff, landing and Vanilla 1.12 accessibility remain unverified.
notes: Roogug is an optional side branch. Aggem and Jargba occupy separate branches off the common ramp; return to the junction between them.
Earthcaller Halmgar and Blind Hunter are rare spawns. Their absence does not change the route.
Q2 represents a search area for the Snufflenose Gopher, not a fixed tuber spawn. Q5 represents bat drops across the cavern.
Q3 and Q4 share the prison area. Willix must be escorted toward E; the exact escort track is not drawn.
Agathelos is in a dead-end spur behind a ward. Kill the Ward Keepers to remove the barrier.
Q1 and Q6 refer to boss loot. Q6 covers the faction objectives and the Small Scroll quest starter.
Panels are schematic route sections, not to scale. Local rises are indicated by arrows. No teleporter is present.
